title: Locked-Rate Surcharge for Missed Maintenance — Comfort Club
content:
The locked rate of a reinstated Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements term carries a surcharge when the agreement's maintenance has not been kept.

**Maintenance surcharge rule.** Count the completed cooling or heating tune-ups on the agreement dated within the 12 months before the date of handling:
- none — the no-maintenance surcharge of **10.00 USD** is added;
- exactly one — the single-tune-up surcharge of **5.00 USD** is added;
- two or more — nothing is added.

Whole-home visits and forfeited visits are not completed cooling or heating tune-ups and do not count.

### Cases (hypothetical agreements)
| Completed cooling or heating tune-ups in the 12 months | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 0 | 10.00 |
| 1 (a heating tune-up 7 months ago) | 5.00 |
| 2 (cooling 4 months ago, heating 10 months ago) | 0.00 |
| 1 within the 12 months and 1 dated 14 months ago | 5.00 |
